verdict.rationale: Linear ships an in-app assistant, Linear Agent, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the agent learning a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences. Shareable skills standardize workflows, which is an adjacent feature and does not amount to personalized learning of user style.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
